findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document reads
findings.body: When the user and document belong to different tenants, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` instead of rejecting access. Any caller relying on this predicate for authorization can expose documents across tenant boundaries. Preserve the tenant equality check rather than granting every read.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now returns `true` for every input, allowing a user from any tenant to read another tenant’s document whenever `userTenant !== documentTenant`. This is a cross-tenant authorization bypass.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
